verdict.rationale: Ashby ships a native analytics module. Its marketing page names offer acceptance rate by team, average time in process, and breakdowns by source, all covered by out-of-the-box reports, customizable templates, and a custom report builder. However, these metrics appear only as rhetorical examples on marketing pages, and stage-to-stage conversion is never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit stage-conversion funnel reporting, documented time-to-hire and source-effectiveness metrics per role, in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team

citations.quote: We’ve got you covered with out of the box reports, customizable templates, and a report builder to build your own from scratch.
